abstract_text_before_after.source: 高校课题组需保存实验目的、条件、材料、操作过程与结果，支持协作、追溯和复用。纸质记录本与个人文档中的记录分散保存，增加查阅、版本核对和交接难度，也妨碍实验对象的结构化利用。本文据此设计并实现具有项目权限、审核流程和来源追溯能力的智能电子实验笔记系统，统一管理实验记录并核对来源。
abstract_text_before_after.candidate: 高校课题组需保存实验目的、条件、材料、操作过程与结果，以支持协作、追溯和复用。纸质记录本与个人文档分散保存，增加了记录查阅、版本核对和工作交接的难度，也不利于实验信息的结构化管理。为此，本文设计并实现智能电子实验笔记系统，通过统一管理实验记录、设置项目权限和审核流程，支持记录查询与来源核对。

abstract_text_before_after.source: 系统面向高校课题组成员、审核人员和项目负责人，由管理员维护账号与全局权限。成员编写笔记、保存版本并上传附件和知识文档；审核人员批准或退回记录；项目负责人管理成员及权限。资料审核后归档，扫描件经光学字符识别与人工校对后可入库。系统提供知识图谱与来源浏览、项目问答与评价、固定任务生成、计划覆盖核对、按需预警和审计查询。

abstract_text_before_after.source: 系统以Next.js构建界面，Rust/Axum实现接口，PostgreSQL/pgvector保存记录与向量，DeepSeek完成生成。笔记审核通过后，系统依据结构化字段、明确类型标记及领域规则映射对象与关系，更新带来源的图谱；计划预期独立保存，与已审核知识匹配。资料经审核、分块和向量化后参与项目内混合检索。固定任务按模板组织证据，会话工具调用受项目授权约束，高风险调用经人工确认，写入受幂等约束，并记录来源与操作日志。
abstract_text_before_after.candidate: 系统采用Next.js构建前端、Rust/Axum实现后端接口，使用PostgreSQL/pgvector保存记录与向量，并调用DeepSeek生成内容。笔记审核通过后，系统依据结构化字段、明确的类型标记和领域规则映射实验对象及其关系，更新可回查来源的知识图谱；计划中的预期知识单独保存，与已审核知识匹配。资料经审核、分块和向量化后，用于项目内混合检索。固定任务按模板组织证据；会话工具调用受项目授权约束，高风险调用需人工确认，写入需满足幂等约束，并记录来源与操作日志。

abstract_text_before_after.source: 本文工程贡献包括：（1）以审核状态控制知识更新，将独立保存的计划与已审核知识进行匹配；（2）联合检索资料片段与直接关系并回查来源，比较事实覆盖与生成成本；（3）以项目权限、人工确认与幂等约束控制智能辅助，使生成与工具写入遵循授权、审核与审计规则。

abstract_text_before_after.source: 归档的8个浏览器端到端场景及8项确认与幂等测试均通过。12条公开英文日记的自然正文抽取F1为0.00%，正确字段条件下的映射F1为97.33%；四条合成样例在当前Rust的内容关系回归F1为98.77%，中文自然正文需另行评价。早期20题普通与图谱增强问答完成数为4/20和14/20，原始引用格式及范围合格数为17/20和15/20，语义支持改善仍不确定。Rust四组配置生成144条回答，一跳关系与资料检索的事实覆盖率为74.44%和46.67%，题级p=0.0938，未达到0.05阈值。一跳关系覆盖低于全文笔记和全部三元组、Token耗用较少，呈现本题集的覆盖与成本取舍，尚未确证图结构的独立增益。角色接口验证用于核对业务约束。

abstract_text_before_after.source: University research groups retain experimental objectives, conditions, materials, procedures, and results for collaboration and reuse. Paper notebooks and scattered files hinder record checking, version management, and handovers. This thesis designs and implements an electronic laboratory notebook with unified records, project permissions, review workflows, and verifiable sources.
abstract_text_before_after.candidate: University research groups retain experimental objectives, conditions, materials, procedures, and results for collaboration, traceability, and reuse. Scattered paper and digital records hinder retrieval, version checking, and handovers. This thesis develops an intelligent electronic laboratory notebook with unified records, project permissions, review workflows, and traceable sources.

abstract_text_before_after.source: Members edit and version notes, upload materials, and correct scanned records; reviewers approve records; project leaders manage membership and permissions; administrators maintain accounts and global access. Features include archiving, graph and source browsing, project question answering and evaluation, fixed-task generation, plan-coverage checks, on-demand alerts, and audit queries.

Features include archiving, graph and source browsing, project question answering and evaluation, fixed-task generation, plan-coverage checks, on-demand alerts, and audit queries.

abstract_text_before_after.source: The three engineering contributions are: (1) review-driven knowledge updates and coverage checks matching separate plans with reviewed knowledge; (2) joint retrieval of document passages and direct relations with source verification, comparing fact coverage and generation cost; and (3) AI assistance under project authorization, human confirmation, idempotency, and audit rules.
abstract_text_before_after.candidate: Next.js provides the frontend and Rust/Axum the APIs; PostgreSQL/pgvector stores records and embeddings; DeepSeek generates content. After note approval, the system uses structured fields, explicit type markers, and domain rules to map source-linked objects and relations. Approved documents support project-scoped hybrid retrieval; templates organize task evidence. Tools require project authorization, high-risk calls need human confirmation, and idempotency constrains writes. Sources and operations are logged.

Approved documents support project-scoped hybrid retrieval, and templates organize task evidence. abstract_text_before_after.source: The archived results showed that eight browser scenarios and eight confirmation and idempotency tests passed. On 12 public English diary entries, natural-prose extraction yielded F1=0.00%, while mapping correct structured fields yielded F1=97.33%; content-relation regression testing on four synthetic notes yielded 98.77% in Rust. Chinese prose requires separate evaluation. Ordinary and graph-enhanced prototype question answering completed 4/20 and 14/20 questions, with original citation checks passing 17/20 and 15/20; semantic support gains remain uncertain. Four Rust configurations produced 144 answers. One-hop relations and documents achieved 74.44% and 46.67% fact coverage (question-level p=0.0938, above 0.05). The one-hop configuration had lower coverage and token use than full notes or all triples. This descriptive coverage–cost tradeoff does not establish an independent benefit of graph structure. Role-based API checks assessed workflow constraints.
